subject: Copywriting
title: The Columbia Record Club Letter
description: A quick, practical guide to The Columbia Record Club Letter.

hook.text: '12 records for a penny.' Columbia Record Club's mail offer signed up 16 million members. The deal was irresistible.

buildup.text: The sales letter promised 12 records for $0.01 if you bought just 4 more at regular price over 2 years.

discovery.text: The math was genius: the 'penny' offer was actually full-priced when obligations were included.

twist.text: Members who forgot to decline the 'selection of the month' received unwanted records and were billed.

climax.text: The business model inspired every subscription box and free trial with auto-renewal.

punchline.text: 12 records for a penny. The offer that invented subscription traps.

quiz.question: How many members did Columbia Record Club sign up?
